title.narrative: Strengthening data systems to improve the management of internally displaced persons referral systems in Iraq 00140668

description.narrative: To address the ongoing challenges of internal displacement in Iraq, this project focuses on three transformational outcomes: harmonizing data management systems between the Government of Iraq and the UN Country Team, improving access and efficiency in compensation claims for displaced populations, and developing a national financing policy for durable solutions.
